name: unicode-normalize
title: Unicode Normalize
description: Unicode cleanup for text pipelines: NFC/NFKC normalization, whitespace folding and removal of invisible characters.
input_unit: bytes of UTF-8 text (NFKC; generated mix of Japanese and English sentences; 11 of the 34 sentence patterns contain full-width, half-width or other characters that NFKC changes)

usage.python:
from kura_rs import unicode_normalize

# Remove invisible characters, NFKC, then fold whitespace (always in this order)
clean = unicode_normalize.normalize(raw, form="NFKC", fold_whitespace=True, strip_invisible=True)

# Same as unicodedata.normalize("NFC", text); unchanged text is returned as is
unicode_normalize.normalize("e\u0301", "NFC")
unicode_normalize.is_normalized(text, "NFKC")

# Many texts at once (the GIL is released for the whole batch)
cleaned = unicode_normalize.normalize_many(texts, "NFKC", fold_whitespace=True, strip_invisible=True)
